( xi ) Wet natural gas composition. Measure this parameter using one of the methods described in paragraphs (e)(1)(xi)(A) and (B) of this section. ( A ) Use an appropriate standard method published by a consensus-based standards organization if such a method exists or you may use an industry standard practice as specified in § 98.234(b) to sample and analyze wet natural gas composition. ( B ) If only composition data for dry natural gas is available, assume the wet natural gas is saturated. ( 2 ) Calculation Method 2.
